title: The Warden-marked entry 'press him plainly, watch to watch' (talking to the Free Companies' paymaster) produces only a flavor rebuff - 'He goes flat... Ask your chest business elsewhere' - with no xp tag, no standing change, and no state change of any kind. Every other Warden entry I tried (about a dozen, across all four holds visited) changed something; this one was pure dead air, and I had to fall back on the ordinary will-check option to actually make progress with him.
where: The Paymaster's Chest-Room, Pennywell / talk to Dray
